headword: {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}

definitions.explanation: Describes a person or behavior focused primarily on one's own interests, needs, or perspective without regard for others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改|あらた}めた→改める：12923_aratameru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should change your self-centered way of thinking.

examples.japanese: {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧いく。
examples.english: If you keep acting selfishly, people around you will drift away.

notes:
USAGE:
Often abbreviated in casual speech to {自己中|じこちゅう} (or ジコチュー). The abbreviation is common among younger speakers and is slightly more informal and blunt.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a self-centered person)
- {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧ (a self-centered way of thinking)
- {自己中心的|じこちゅうしんてき}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (selfish behavior)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{利己的|りこてき}→利己的：21285_rikoteki⟧: selfish — more formal, emphasizes pursuing personal gain
- {我|わ}がまま: selfish, spoiled — more emotional and everyday
- {自己中|じこちゅう}: abbreviated casual form of this word
